Colonel Marina Maru is a former Japanese soldier and the current leader of Poison, a private paramilitary group with a deadly reputation. True to her moniker, Doctor Poison is an expert toxicologist who has weaponized and developed all manner of poisons, chemicals, and bio-agents. Her most notable creation is the Maru Virus, which turns all those infected uncontrollably violent and murderous.
A Japanese soldier turned paramilitary mercenary, Doctor Poison is an expert toxicologist with a sadistic streak who engineers and weaponizes her own poisons.
Doctor Poison left the Japanese military to form a paramilitary group.

Marina Maru was once a colonel in the Japanese military, where she developed her tactical, analytic, and leadership abilities. At some point, Marina decided to leave the service to form her own paramilitary group. There she was able to pursue her true passion and her family's business—poisons, even going so far as to name the group itself Poison. A genius toxicologist untethered by a sense of morality or ethics, she has developed and perfected the lethality of countless poisons, toxins, and chemicals. Perhaps the most dangerous of them all is her signature Maru Virus, a bio-agent based off of Soviet combat drugs from the Cold War. It floods its victims with adrenaline and impairs their reasoning, driving them to commit insatiable violence and even murder.
Doctor Poison has an arsenal of poisons and chemicals at her disposal.

Whether it's delivered via syringe or gas, Doctor Poison has found a way to weaponize all manner of poisons, toxins, chemicals, and bio-agents. That, combined with her tactical mind and military training make her a deadly threat.
Without access to her poisons, Doctor Poison is relatively defenseless.

Though Doctor Poison is skilled in firearms and hand-to-hand combat, depriving her of access to her poisons greatly diminishes her threat capacity. Likewise, an immunity to poisons could take the sting out of her attacks. She has also proven to be susceptible to at least some of her own poisons, should one find a way to use them against her.

Kal-El is weak to Kryptonite - radioactive fragments from his destroyed homeworld that can drain his strength, cause severe pain, and eventually kill him with prolonged exposure.

Absolute Superman is always at risk of overextending himself, draining himself of the solar energy that gives him superhuman powers. On top of it, the villains of Earth and other worlds are plotting against him, trying to make Kal-El break his moral code and betray his sense of justice and mercy.

Armed with a suit of Kryptonian armor that was modified by his mother, Kal-El can survive in deep space for long periods of time, use its solar reserves to heal himself, and take the blows that put even Kryptonians to the test. And then there's the power of Earth’s yellow sun.

But with its power, Absolute Superman possesses a vast range of superhuman abilities, including immense strength capable of lifting enormous objects and overpowering nearly any opponent, near-invulnerability that allows him to withstand bullets, explosions, and extreme environmental conditions, and the power of flight that lets him move freely across the world.
